# mbti questionnaire availability

Status: unavailable_pending_rights. The questionnaire is not included in AgentTune content 1.0.0. Document adaptations and attribution; enable only for a use covered by these terms or additional written permission.

[Original publisher](https://openpsychometrics.org/tests/OJTS/development/OEJTS1.2.pdf) · [Choose communication preferences](https://agent-tune.com/tools/custom-instructions-generator) · [Browse templates](https://agent-tune.com/library)

The framework's optional communication templates remain available. They are editorial suggestions, not questionnaire results or diagnoses. Historical research used an AgentTune adaptation; see the release's legacy provenance record.
